name: Film and Media Studies (Min)

rules.notes:
Courses may not be offered every year and are subject to change. Consult the Student Services Specialist if a course is not listed below.
Courses that use film and media to simply illustrate a cultural topic may not be considered. Only those courses that center on film and media and use the methods of film and media study may be used toward completion of the minor.

rules.name: Elective Courses
rules.desc: Students must complete 3 additional FILMEDIA and FILMPROD courses. Up to two Film Production (FILMPROD) courses may count toward completion of the minor. Current FILMEDIA and FILMPROD course offerings can be found on Navigate Classes.
rules.notes: For courses cross-listed between Film and Media Studies and another Stanford department or program, FMS minors should enroll for the FILMEDIA course listing.

grading: All courses must be taken for a letter grade.
policies:
No more than one elective can be chosen from courses in another department for its stress on methods of film analysis and only with the approval of the student's minor advisor. Electives may include courses in national cinemas, film genres, experimental and documentary film, or film theory.
Art Practice courses may not be used toward the requirements.
transferPolicy: A maximum of one course (up to 5 units) from other universities and the Stanford Bing Overseas Program may be applied to the 29 total units required for the minor.
reviewNotes: Every course must be letter graded. The minor is the four required courses (FILMEDIA 4, 6 and 102, and one of FILMEDIA 100A, 100B or 100C) and three more FILMEDIA or FILMPROD courses with at most two FILMPROD courses, for 29 units. One elective from another department that stresses film analysis counts with your minor advisor's approval and is moved in by hand; Art Practice courses do not count, and at most one course (5 units) from other universities or Bing Overseas Studies applies.
